periods.label: 破城舰

appearance.overview: Large bald male student in a long uniform, wielding a huge zanbatō Device.

personality.summary: Bold, old-fashioned and proud of direct frontal challenge, declaring that a Japanese man never retreats.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Opponent who overpowers his ten-ton strike head-on.
relationships.renren-tomaru: Ranked just below her and poorly matched against her speed.

periods.summary: Rai challenges Stella in her ninth selection battle. He reveals that each swing of his zanbatō accumulates weight up to ten tons and attacks with Crescendo Axe. Stella deliberately receives the blow, overpowers it with raw A-rank strength, and blasts him unconscious at close range.

key_events.summary: Stella defeats Rai by overpowering his fully charged heavy slash.
